answer: A new identity needs an established sponsor. The sponsor locks 300 POA for ten epochs per vouch and may back only two accounts, so nobody can forge a crowd alone; two graded zeros on the newcomer send that stake to the panel. Fifty clones need 25 sponsors with real history, 20 answered epochs each, ten hours of writing, 250 hours total, or $30 an identity secondhand, plus 7,500 POA frozen for two and a half days. Read through that prism, a farm's own signatures weigh nothing while outsiders sign its ledger. A marble column is worth its vein, not the certificate glued to the base.
